name: Banner
cardDesc: Full-bleed hero banner with image or video background, title, subtitle, CTA button, and loading shimmer.
previewHtml:
Summer Collection 2026

Discover the new season — up to 50% off on selected items.

Shop Now

examples.svelte:
<script lang="ts">
  import Banner from '@chronos-ui/core/svelte/Banner.svelte';
  import '@chronos-ui/core/theme.css';
</script>

<Banner
  title="Summer Collection 2026"
  subtitle="Discover the new season"
  ctaText="Shop Now"
  textAlignment="center"
  media={{ type: 'image', url: '/hero.jpg' }}
  mapLinks={[{ url: '/shop' }]}
/>
examples.wc:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/@chronos-ui/core/theme.css">
<script type="module"
  src="node_modules/@chronos-ui/core/webcomponents/Banner.js"></script>

<banner
  title="Summer Collection 2026"
  subtitle="Discover the new season"
  cta-text="Shop Now"
  text-alignment="center"
></banner>

notes.text: Theming: Override --chronos-color-primary in your stylesheet to change the CTA button colour.
Video background: Set media.type = 'video' — the component renders a muted, autoplayed, looped <video> positioned absolutely behind the overlay.

api.desc: Call to action button text. Omit to hide the button.
Background media object. { type: "image" | "video", url: string }
Link for the CTA. { url: string }

name: Announcement Bar

previewHtml: 🚀 Free shipping on orders over $75 — Shop the sale →

name: Alternating Slider
cardDesc: Multi-column slider where adjacent columns scroll in opposite vertical directions for a dramatic reveal effect.
previewCss: #alt-slider-demo{position:relative;width:100%;height:260px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:10px;background:#000;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr} .alt-col{height:100%;overflow:hidden} .alt-col-track{height:100%;transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1)} .alt-card{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;color:#fff} .alt-card h3{font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:800;text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.8);margin-bottom:.4rem;text-align:center} .alt-card p{font-size:.85rem;text-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.8);opacity:.9} .ds-a1{background:url('../assets/images/new_arrivals.png') center/cover} .ds-a2{background:url('../assets/images/accessories.png') center/cover} .ds-a3{background:url('../assets/images/summer_sale.png') center/cover} .ds-a4{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a0533,#3b0764)} .demo-arrow{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border:none;border-radius:50%;width:38px;height:38px;color:#fff;font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;z-index:10;transition:background .2s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center} .demo-arrow:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.3)} .demo-arrow.prev{left:14px} .demo-arrow.next{right:14px} .demo-dots{position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:8px;z-index:10} .demo-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #fff;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;padding:0} .demo-dot.active{background:#fff;transform:scale(1.3)}

notes.text: Column grouping: Items are grouped into slide-sets automatically. With columns: 2 and 4 items you get 2 slide-sets of 2. Keep items.length a multiple of columns for best results.

name: Timer Widget
cardDesc: Live countdown timer updating every second. Shows days, hours, minutes, and seconds to any target date.
previewHtml:
⏳ Sale ends in:
0Days
0Hours
0Minutes
0Seconds

examples.svelte:
<script lang="ts">
  import TimerWidget from '@chronos-ui/core/svelte/TimerWidget.svelte';
</script>

<TimerWidget
  title="Sale ends in:"
  targetDate="2026-12-31T23:59:59Z"
/>

notes.text: Past dates: When targetDate is in the past all values show 0. Update or remove the component via your CMS when the countdown expires.
SSR: The timer renders 0 on the server then hydrates on the client, avoiding any hydration mismatch.

api.desc: ISO 8601 UTC date string to count down to (e.g. "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z").
